ValidationRule.description: Prevents updates to qualification-related Opportunity fields once the Opportunity reaches Booking Verification or later stages, unless the user has the appropriate override permission.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Opportunity_Fields_Locked__c = TRUE, NOT(Bypass_Validation__c), NOT( AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booked"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Setup"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed") ) ) ), OR( ISCHANGED(Business_Problem_Evidenced__c), ISCHANGED(Impact_Consequences_Identified__c), ISCHANGED(Decision_Process_Defined__c), ISCHANGED(Customer_Outcome_Predefined__c), ISCHANGED(Budget_Validated__c), ISCHANGED(Add_On__c), ISCHANGED(InSight_Opportunities__c), ISCHANGED(Insight_Use_Case_Other__c), ISCHANGED(Digital_Deal_Archetype__c), ISCHANGED(Is_InSight_being_proposed__c), ISCHANGED(InSight_not_in_proposal_Explanation__c), ISCHANGED(Billing_Country__c), ISCHANGED(Primary_Product_Line__c), ISCHANGED(Multi_Business_Unit__c), ISCHANGED(CloseDate), ISCHANGED(Cloud_Provider__c), ISCHANGED(US_Federal_GSA_Pricing__c), ISCHANGED(Group_Purchasing_Organization_GPO__c), ISCHANGED(NextStep), ISCHANGED(Next_Step_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Amount), ISCHANGED(Deal_Type__c), ISCHANGED(Billing_Account__c), ISCHANGED(Upsell_Customer_ID__c), ISCHANGED(IM_Up_Sell_Sold_To__c), ISCHANGED(Service_Address__c), ISCHANGED(Remarketing_Required__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fields cannot be edited once the Opportunity reaches a restricted sales stage.
